					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_SYR_requirement_f9ef95bb7e859fcd
						check_variable = { party_banned_array^22 = 0 }
					}
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_SYR_requirement_a443fe07c483e518
						check_variable = { party_pop_array^22 > 0.049999 }
					}
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							custom_trigger_tooltip = {
								tooltip = COLDWAR_SYR_requirement_5fdda66e00aa843e
								check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
							}
							custom_trigger_tooltip = {
								tooltip = COLDWAR_SYR_requirement_4b989b0cd9e509a8
								is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 22 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SYR_POL.27.option_c_outcome_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = SYR
					IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
					check_variable = { party_banned_array^22 = 0 }
					check_variable = { party_pop_array^22 > 0.049999 }
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
							is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 22 }
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { add_col_one = 22 }
				add_coalition_members_effect = yes
				COLDWAR_SYR_refresh_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
	option = { name = COLDWAR_SYR_close_consultations }
